query: What cost/benefit thresholds (acceptable % slowdown, minimum expected build-time savings, and trace volume limits) should trigger runtime optimizations or fallback to coarse-grained tracing?

response.query: What cost/benefit thresholds (acceptable % slowdown, minimum expected build-time savings, and trace volume limits) should trigger runtime optimizations or fallback to coarse-grained tracing?
response.answer: Trigger runtime optimizations at 10% slowdown; fallback to coarse-grained tracing if build-time savings are below 20% and trace volume exceeds 1 MB.
